svg.title: rustprofile profile viewer UI preview
svg.desc: Static preview of the rustprofile profile viewer: session, window, and thread controls; profile metrics; a sample timeline; a CPU flame graph; a Hot functions table; and a Ready status bar. This illustration is not a captured profile output.

g.title: rustprofile::serve — 100 percent of selected CPU time

decode_profile — 41 percent of selected CPU time
render_view — 28 percent of selected CPU time

g.text: Click a frame to zoom · matched frames use the orange search highlight
